izzyondroid:com.audiosoftware.jaliscope.name: Jaliscope
izzyondroid:com.audiosoftware.jaliscope.summary: A vectorscope program centered around performance, accuracy, and customizability
izzyondroid:com.audiosoftware.jaliscope.description:
This is an audio visualizer program , it takes audio files and converts them to lines rendered on screen where you can modify them as you desire with the functions available inside the buttons! Such program is sometimes classified as a Vectorscope Program , or a Lissajous Plot program to be specific.
 First thing you see when you boot up the program is a rendering of the sound being currently played, and they are being used to play a nice tune.
 HOW was it made?
 The program is built using C++ , and by using the SDL3 library for the renderings, and the MINIAUDIO single-header library for the audio playback buffering.
 CONTROLS
 When you tap the screen, 9 buttons in abstract minimal style shows up, layered on the edges of the screen before you, each one of them has a functionality.
 Make a double tap under 500 milliseconds , and the audio stops, the rendering with it.
 Starting clockwise from the bottom left, we have:
 SCALE: scales up, or down, the rendering window of the lines, it doesn't scale up the rendering view, but rather scales up the allowed space the lines can render in!
 MISCELLANEOUS: houses many options and settings that affects the rendering and sound, like Rotating the rendered lines! or Adjusting the audio buffer's size! or saving your preferences and many more!
 FILE: Clicking it opens the platform's file selector for choosing the audio file you wish to render.
 THEME: shows 3 slider bars for changing the theme of the program as a whole, Red bar on the left, Green bar on the bottom, Blue bar on the right, making all colors zero won't make the GUI invisible, so don't worry about that :D
 SPLINES: One of the most fun parts of the program. It allows you to change the number of lines that are drawn onto screen! Making a soothing real-time drawing of the lines, or letting you draw over 8000 lines on screen in a second. it's your choice!
 X/Y PADDING: lets you move the rendering in any position without screen bounds!
 SPEED: resamples the sample rate of the audio, which changes the pitch and tempo of the audio down the thousandth (0.001)!
 SEEKER: instant seeking to any part of the audio down the milliseconds, with the audio time being on-top the seeking bar.
 VOLUME: As the name and button suggests, you change the in-program audio volume.
 Some Quirks
 Changing the frames chunk size can flush the audio buffer, which skips some chunk of the audio, with this, you can flush the buffers on the audio's halfbeat to make the audio play in a swing rhythm!
 Rotating the rendering fast enough can give a stroboscopic effect for the rendering lines. In my opinion, this is very mesmerizing!
 Add that with the splines changing at your whim, and you'd get a virtually infinite numbers of combos!
 IMPORTANT NOTES!
 For now, the app can ONLY process the following audio formats: FLAC , WAV , MP3 . Ogg, and Opus formats, will be supported in future releases.

fdroid:com.goldmaster.im2sms.name: IM2SMS
fdroid:com.goldmaster.im2sms.summary: A simple app to import IM chat histories into Android’s SMS storage.
fdroid:com.goldmaster.im2sms.description:
A simple app to import IM chat histories into Android’s SMS storage.
 Features 
 Easy Import: 
Import chats directly from an IM app's share menu or by browsing the phone's storage for exported chat files.
 Chat Preview: 
Preview individual chats before importing into SMS.
 Material You: 
The app's theme and icon automatically adapts to the phone's wallpaper and system colours.
 Dark Mode: 
Automatically switches between light and dark themes based on the phone's settings.
 Supported Apps 
 Currently Supported: 
 WhatsApp: Use the 'Export chat' option within WhatsApp and share the exported file with IM2SMS. Or browse previously exported chats and view both individual and group chats.
 Planned Support: 
 Facebook Messenger: Support for importing from a Facebook data takeout is planned.
 Telegram: Future support is planned.
 Signal: Future support is planned via backup files or secure backups.
 FAQ 
 Will an iOS version be available? 
No. Due to technical limitations, iOS does not allow third-party apps to write to the SMS database.
 Why export to SMS? 
SMS is a universal, device-native format. By converting chat histories to SMS, you get a durable, open-standard backup that isn't locked into a single proprietary app.
 Why the name? 
The name stands for Instant Messenger to SMS. It reflects the app’s broad support for multiple IM platforms beyond just WhatsApp.
 Can group chats be imported? 
There is basic support for importing group chats, however, there are significant limitations due to how Android and apps like Google Messages handle the legacy SMS/MMS storage. At present, there is no way for third-party apps to programmatically set a group chat name in the system's SMS database that Google Messages will recognise, so the chat name will typically appear as a list of participant numbers. Additionally, a "Mass Text" warning may show if Google Messages cannot verify that all participants are using modern RCS (Rich Communication Services). To fully continue a group chat as a single thread, all members must be using RCS. Once everyone is on RCS, the group chat should automatically "upgrade" and function as a normal group thread.
 Can I use IM2SMS to back up my existing SMS messages? 
No. The core purpose of IM2SMS is to import Instant Messenger chat histories into the phone's SMS storage. Creating backups of existing SMS messages is already well-supported by other dedicated apps.
 Why does the app have to be set as the default SMS app? 
Android only allows the current default SMS app to write to the system's message database. To import chats, IM2SMS must temporarily become the default app. After the import process completes, opening the preferred messaging app provides a prompt to restore it as the default.

 equation display is simplified upon pressing enter.  light/dark themes
 previous input history can be accessed and edited by pressing "up" or "down" buttons.
 previous inputs/vars/recently used units preserved when the app is closed
 standard scientific calculator features, such as:
 trigonometric functions: sin, cos, tan, arcsin, arccos, arctan
 base 10 and natural logarithmic functions: log (base 10), ln (base e)

flathub:com.dosbox_x.DOSBox-X.description:
DOSBox-X is an open-source DOS emulator for running DOS games and applications.
DOS-based Windows such as Windows 3.x and Windows 9x are officially supported.
Compared to DOSBox, DOSBox-X is much more flexible and provides more features.
 DOSBox-X emulates a PC necessary for running many DOS games and applications that simply cannot be run on modern PCs and operating systems, similar to DOSBox. However, while the main focus of DOSBox is for running DOS games, DOSBox-X goes much further than this. Started as a fork of the DOSBox project, it retains compatibility with the wide base of DOS games and DOS gaming DOSBox was designed for. But it is also a platform for running DOS applications, including emulating the environments to run Windows 3.x, 9x and ME and software written for those versions of Windows. By adding official support for Windows 95, 98, and ME emulation and acceleration, we hope that those old Windows games and applications could be enjoyed or used once more. Moreover, DOSBox-X adds support for emulating the NEC PC-98 such that you can also play PC-98 games with it.
 DOSBox-X emulates a legacy IBM PC and DOS environment, and has many emulation options which you can find documented on the DOSBox-X website.

fedora-packages:bsp/bsp.name: bsp

fedora-packages:bsp/bsp.description: Before you can play a level that you have created, you must use a node builder to create the data that Doom will use to render the level. Doom uses a rendering algorithm based on a binary space partition, otherwise known as a BSP tree. This is stored in a data lump called NODES in the WAD file. This data structure must be pre-calculated and stored in the WAD file before the level can be played; the tool that does this is called a node builder. BSP is one of several node builders that can do this. There are others: idbsp is the original node builder that id Software used on the original Doom levels, for instance. BSP was the best known and most widely used node builder throughout the height of the Doom editing craze in the mid 1990s.

fedora-packages:gfs-theokritos-fonts/gfs.description: Yannis Kefallinos (1894–1958) was one of the most innovative engravers of his generation and the first who researched methodically the aesthetics of book and typographic design in Greece. He taught at the Fine Arts School of Athens and established the first book design workshop from which many practicing artists of the 60’s and 70’s had graduated. In the late 50’s Kefallinos designed and published an exquisite book with engraved illustrations of the ancient white funerary pottery in Attica in collaboration with Varlamos, Montesanto, Damianakis. For the text of Kefallinos’ Δέκα λευκαί λήκυθοι (1956) the artist used a typeface which he himself had designed a few years before for an unrealized edition of Theocritos’ Idyls. Its complex and heavily decorative design does point to aesthetic codes which preoccupied his artistic expression and, although impractical for contemporary text setting, it remains an original display face, or it can be used as initials. The book design workshop of the Fine Arts School of Athens has been recently reorganized, under the direction of professor Leoni Vidali, and with her collaboration George D. Matthiopoulos has redesigned digitally this historical font which is now available as GFS Theokritos.

fedora-packages:ghc-esqueleto/ghc-esquel.name: ghc-esqueleto
fedora-packages:ghc-esqueleto/ghc-esquel.summary: Type-safe EDSL for SQL queries on persistent backends
fedora-packages:ghc-esqueleto/ghc-esquel.description: 'esqueleto' is a bare bones, type-safe EDSL for SQL queries that works with unmodified 'persistent' SQL backends. Its language closely resembles SQL, so you don't have to learn new concepts, just new syntax, and it's fairly easy to predict the generated SQL and optimize it for your backend. Most kinds of errors committed when writing SQL are caught as compile-time errors---although it is possible to write type-checked 'esqueleto' queries that fail at runtime. 'persistent' is a library for type-safe data serialization. It has many kinds of backends, such as SQL backends ('persistent-mysql', 'persistent-postgresql', 'persistent-sqlite') and NoSQL backends ('persistent-mongoDB'). While 'persistent' is a nice library for storing and retrieving records, including with filters, it does not try to support some of the features that are specific to SQL backends. In particular, 'esqueleto' is the recommended library for type-safe 'JOIN's on 'persistent' SQL backends. (The alternative is using raw SQL, but that's error prone and does not offer any composability.) Currently, 'SELECT's, 'UPDATE's, 'INSERT's and 'DELETE's are supported. Not all SQL features are available, but most of them can be easily added (especially functions), so please open an issue or send a pull request if you need anything that is not covered by 'esqueleto' on <https://github.com/bitemyapp/esqueleto>. The name of this library means "skeleton" in Portuguese and contains all three SQL letters in the correct order =). It was inspired by Scala's Squeryl but created from scratch.

fedora-packages:ghc-hashable/ghc-hashabl.description: This package defines a class, 'Hashable', for types that can be converted to a hash value. This class exists for the benefit of hashing-based data structures. The package provides instances for basic types and a way to combine hash values. 'Hashable' is intended exclusively for use in in-memory data structures. 'Hashable' does /not/ have a fixed standard. This allows it to improve over time. Because it does not have a fixed standard, different computers or computers on different versions of the code will observe different hash values. As such, 'hashable' is not recommended for use other than in-memory datastructures. Specifically, 'hashable' is not intended for network use or in applications which persist hashed values. For stable hashing use named hashes: sha256, crc32, xxhash etc.

firefox-addons:3059944.name: Facebook Privacy Guard
firefox-addons:3059944.summary: Blur Facebook profile pictures, usernames, imaAutomatically blur Facebook profile pictures, usernames, images, and videos to help protect your privacy while browsing.ges and videos for privacy.
firefox-addons:3059944.description:
Facebook Privacy Guard helps protect your privacy while browsing Facebook by automatically blurring selected visual and identifying content.
Features:
• Blurs Facebook profile pictures.
• Blurs usernames and selected identifying text.
• Blurs images and videos on Facebook.
• Works automatically on supported Facebook pages.
• Provides a simple popup for enabling or disabling the protection.
• Uses local browser settings to remember your preferences.
Privacy:
This extension does not collect, store, sell, or transmit personal data. It does not send Facebook content, browsing history, usernames, images, or videos to any external server. The blur processing is performed locally in your browser.
Permissions:
The extension requires access to Facebook pages so it can identify and blur selected content. The storage permission is used only to save your local extension preferences.
This extension is an independent privacy tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Facebook or Meta Platforms, Inc.

firefox-addons:740644.name: Toggl Track: Productivity & Time Tracker
firefox-addons:740644.summary: Puts a timer into any web tool and allows quick real time productivity tracking with all the data stored on your Toggl Track account. Time tracking has never been easier!
firefox-addons:740644.description:
Whether you use Salesforce, Producteev, Slack, Trello, Todoist, Asana, Basecamp, Google Drive or one of the 90+ integrated tools, start tracking time without opening a new tab. Toggl Track timer can now also fill your Pomodoro needs through automated reminders.
If you were looking for Toggl Button, you're in the right place -> we've just rebranded as Toggl Track, but the functionality of the extension remains the same (and we also switched colors a bit as well).
Toggl Track extension is already available in: Toggl Plan, Pivotal Tracker, Github, Asana, Unfuddle, Gitlab, Trello, Worksection, Redbooth, Podio, Basecamp, JIRA, Producteev, Bitbucket, Stifer, Google Docs, Redmine, YouTrack, CapsuleCRM, Xero, Zendesk, Any.do , Todoist, Trac, Wunderlist, Toodledo, Teamwork.com , Google Mail, Taiga, Habitica, Axosoft, Countersoft Gemini, Drupal, Esa, Help Scout, Flow, Sprintly, Google Calendar, TestRail, Bugzilla, Breeze, BamBam, GQueue, Wrike, Assembla, Waffle, Codeable, Salesforce, Salesforce Lightning, Draftin, FogBugz, Google Keep, Gingko, Google Inbox, Wordpress, Kanbanery, Planbox, Zoho Books, Slack, Doit.im , Sunrise Calendar, Cloudes, eProject.me , Freshdesk, Newsletter2Go, Gogs, DevDocs, LiquidPlanner, SourceLair, Remember The Milk, Evernote, MantisHub, TargetProcess, VisualStudioOnline (TFS), SmartBoard, Phabricator, OpenProject, SherpaDesk, miniCRM, AgenoCRM, Zube, Rindle, TickTick, Bitrix24, Exana.io , Workfront, OnlyOffice, MeisterTask, Overv.io , Clubhouse.io , Desk.
 Click "+ Add to Firefox".
 Log in to Toggl Track from the extension menu
 You will quickly start noticing the Toggl Track extension in your favorite productivity tools
 Start timer inside one of the supported web tools and the task’s name and project will be added to your Toggl Track time entry.
 Tracking your time will help boost productivity in no time
Toggl Track extension also has advanced features like:
* Pomodoro timer
* Idle detection
* Tracking reminder
Toggl Track extension is open source and we welcome all your contributions, check out our Github repo - https://github.com/toggl/toggl-button 
You can check out the change log here - http://toggl.github.io/toggl-button 
Introduction article is available at: https://support.toggl.com/en/articles/2206984-toggl-track-button-browser-extension 
Privacy
The extension sends your Toggl Track account details and the time entries you track (including descriptions picked up from the page you start a timer on) to Toggl. This is required for it to work.
Usage statistics (via PostHog) and error reports (via Sentry) are optional and off by default. Usage statistics include your Toggl account ID, extension version, browser and operating system details, and which features and integrations you use. Error reports include the error message and stack trace, your Toggl user ID, extension version, and browser and operating system details. Neither ever includes page URLs, page content or time entry details. Both can be turned off at any time in the extension settings under Telemetry.
The data collected in the add-on is also covered by the policies in our Privacy Policy: https://toggl.com/legal/privacy 
Toggl Track Overview
Toggl Track is the leading online time management tool for teams and solo users. It allows users to track the time spent on various projects and analyze productivity. You can use Toggl Track on the web, as a desktop widget or on your mobile – all your data gets synced in real time.
Toggl Track is the ultimate simple online timer. Whether you need to track your work, time online and offline activities or just need a simple stopwatch from time to time, add Toggl Track extension to your browser and see the benefits for yourself.
Join over 3 million productive Togglers!

firefox-addons:2657832.description:

firefox-addons:3009112.name: Web Tools Companion
firefox-addons:3009112.summary: A companion extension for my Web Tools website. Designed to be a utility to automate or help with certain actions without the need of manual insertions to my website.
firefox-addons:3009112.description:
Web Tools Companion ✨
Ever get tired of having to constantly verify your schedule during enrollment and only end up with a dead hour or even have to manually create a weekly schedule? I know, kaumay pre. Now we can make it a lot easier, your welcome :) 
The Web Tools Companion is a browser extension that bridges the gap between FEU Portal (SOLAR & OSES) and the Web Tools, making schedule planning faster, smarter, and more interactive.
🚀 Key Features:
⚡ Real-Time Auto-Sync: As you Load OSES with existing or when Adding and Dropping Subjects, you can now see your schedule in Real-Time through the Web-Tools.
🏝️ Companion Hub (Dynamic Island): A Non-intrusive status overlay injected directly into the portal. Watch when data payloads go outbound from the Portal or Inbound to the Web-Tools.
📡 Secure Messaging Bridge: Your data stays local. I used a secure, ACK-based local handshake to ensure your schedule only ever moves from the portal to your visualizer never to an external server.
🏫 Full Branch Support: Optimized for FEU Tech, with hopes and dreams of compatibility for FEU Alabang and FEU Diliman portals. (sorry cant verify, me no access 😫)
🛠️ How it Works
Open the FEU Enrollment Portal (SOLAR).
Open Web Tools Visualizer or Pre-Requisite Mapping.
Then Proceed to do your actions. Don't worry the extension is on point, it will try to hold hands with you through and through, and if you follow instructions, you might be a Good Boy or a Good Girl.
⚖️ Philosophy & Disclaimer
Both this extension and the Web Tools site are built with a "lightweight and on-point" philosophy. They are designed to be efficient, "use and be done" type of tools, providing exactly what you need for enrollment without unnecessary bloat, complex setups, or background resource heavy lifting.
🌱 An Evolving Project
This extension is a personal project born out of a desire to make enrollment less of a headache. It is an ever-evolving tool, as the main Web Tools site grows and gains new features, this companion will continue to expand with new automations, specialized scrapers, and QoL improvements to match.
🛡️ Privacy First
I believe student data should be private. This extension does not collect, store, or share your personal information. All extraction and synchronization happen entirely within your own browser.
Made with ❤️ for the FEU community.
— Kenneth Davila (imjustapotato)

firefox-addons:2957461.name: QuickTools – Save Page as PDF or Image
firefox-addons:2957461.summary: Save any webpage as a PDF or image with one click. QuickTools captures the page locally in your browser and downloads it instantly — no uploads, no servers, 100% privacy-friendly.
firefox-addons:2957461.description:
QuickTools lets you save any webpage as a PDF or image directly from your browser, with all processing done locally on your device.
What you can do
 • Save the current page as a PDF with one click
 • Save the current page as a PNG image
 • Use the toolbar popup or the right-click context menu
 • Keep your data private – no file uploads, no external servers
 • Quickly open the full QuickTools.one suite of PDF and image utilities when you need more advanced tools
How it works
QuickTools uses browser APIs and client-side libraries to capture the page and generate a PDF or image directly in your browser. The resulting file is downloaded immediately – nothing is sent to any remote server.
Perfect for
 • Saving articles, documentation, and receipts as PDFs
 • Capturing full pages as images for design or dev work
 • Users who care about privacy and prefer local processing
QuickTools.one is a free, privacy-first collection of PDF and image tools that run 100% in your browser. This add-on brings the most useful “save page” features right into Firefox.

firefox-addons:786359.name: Tab Mover
firefox-addons:786359.summary: Move tabs between windows via the context menu.
firefox-addons:786359.description: Tab Mover is a Firefox Addon for quickly moving tabs between windows via the context menu. It can move tabs between two normal windows, two windows in incognito mode and from a normal window to an window in incognito mode. Since it is not possible to directly move a tab from a window in incognito mode to a normal window, Tab Mover can optionally close such a tab and reopen its URL in a normal window.

firefox-addons:4838.name: Multiple Tab Handler
firefox-addons:4838.summary: Allows you to select tabs by dragging and do something.
firefox-addons:4838.description:
This addon provides a panel to select tabs by dragging. After selection you can choose a command to operate selected tabs with a menu. And you can also close multiple tabs directly by dragging on closeboxes.
The menu contains commands compatible to tab context menu of Firefox itself. You can add more commands provided by other tab related addons, for example:
 * Copy Selected Tabs to Clipboard 
 * Save Selected Tabs to Files 
 * Tab Mover 
Moreover, this addon is designed to work with Tree Style Tab . If you install both addons, you can select tabs in the sidebar by dragging . (Note that you need to long-press on a tab to start selection. Otherwise - if you start dragging immediately, it just moves the tab.)

firefox-addons:2971901.name: Roblox Themes – E-ROBLOX: Animated & Static Design
firefox-addons:2971901.summary: E-ROBLOX is a lightweight Firefox extension that enhances Roblox with a variety of free themes, greetings, and smooth integration—safe, fast, and optimized for both PC and mobile devices.
firefox-addons:2971901.description:
E-ROBLOX is a lightweight Firefox extension that enhances your Roblox experience on both PC and mobile with:

firefox-addons:3054818.name: Grok Cosmic Theme
firefox-addons:3054818.summary: Customize Grok with local wallpapers, text and logo colors, OLED/glass effects, transparency controls, and portable theme profiles.
firefox-addons:3054818.description:
Grok Cosmic Theme is an unofficial Firefox customization extension by RatioWorks for personalizing the Grok interface.
Choose from built-in or uploaded wallpapers, customize primary and secondary text colors, change the Grok hero logo tone and transparency, adjust accent colors, and enable OLED, glass, glow, blur, and other visual effects.
Custom wallpapers are processed locally. Settings and exported theme profiles remain on the user's device unless the user manually moves an exported profile file. The extension contains no RatioWorks analytics, telemetry, advertising, or tracking.
Includes quick presets, full reset controls, and profile export/import for transferring a setup to another Firefox installation.
Grok Cosmic Theme is unofficial and is not affiliated with or endorsed by xAI.

apple-itunes:947925763.description:
Join 23M+ travelers using Polarsteps as their all-in-one travel app. Build unique itineraries with the travel planner, let the travel tracker record your route, share the journey with friends and family, and turn it into a photo book to relive later. Whether it's a six-month trip or a weekend canoeing close to home, Polarsteps is here to capture and share your journey as it unfolds.
Awards
■ Top 26 Apps — Apple App Store (2026)
■ Top 3 Travel Apps — Apple App Store (2026)
■ App of the Day — Apple App Store (2025)
PLAN
■ AI itinerary planner: Create a personalized adventure based on past trips or current goals.
■ Destination snapshots: Get a quick overview of each place, why it fits your travel style, and which friends have already been there.
■ Trip details: Add notes, accommodation details, and must-see spots and activities.
■ Transport planner: Choose how you'll get from A to B for every leg of the trip.
■ Inspiration: Follow other explorers, see where they went, and get ideas for your own trips.
TRACK
■ Automatic route tracking: Accurately track the route you took on a beautiful digital world map.
■ Travel Buddies: Invite friends to track trips together.
■ Capture the adventure: Add photos, videos, and stories to each step to bring your journey to life.
■ Travel stats: See how much of the world you’ve traveled, with your total of countries visited, distances covered, and more.
■ Top spots: Add your favorite places and activities so they’re part of your story.
■ Transport mode: Select how you got from place to place, whether by plane, train, or even tuk tuk.
SHARE
■ Trip updates: Share your journey so friends and family can follow along from anywhere, seeing where you are and what you’ve been up to.
■ Traveler tips: Leave suggestions for other travelers on what to see and do.
■ Privacy controls: Decide who sees your adventures: everyone, followers only, or you only.
RELIVE
■ Digital memories: Scroll through the places, photos, stories, and stats you’ve captured across all your trips.
■ Trip Reels: With the press of a button, transform your trip into a memorable video (also perfect to share on socials).
■ Travel Books: Turn your trip into a beautifully printed Travel Book that showcases your route and memories.
WHAT OUR USERS SAY:
“Love this app! It tracks me on my vacation and provides real-time notifications to friends and family of my trip. At the end, I ordered a Travel Book of my photos which is very high quality.”
“The Polarsteps app is great. I am totally addicted. It is so nice to keep up with all your travels. And friends and family can follow you wherever you go. The Travel Book, which you can order afterwards, is of very good quality.”
“I’ve been using this app for years now. It’s always been good and it keeps getting better.”
WHAT THE PRESS ARE SAYING ABOUT POLARSTEPS
“The Polarsteps app replaces your travel journal, making it easier and more beautiful.” - National Geographic
“Polarsteps helps you track and share your journeys in an easy and visually appealing way” - The Next Web
“Polarsteps’ resulting travel log is impressive, and is the source of a severe case of itchy feet in your correspondent.” - TechCrunch

CoreWeight — Everything You Need to Track Your Training.
CoreWeight is a complete workout log for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch.
Track strength training, cardio, body weight, body measurements, progress photos, personal records, and more — all in one place.
Log your workouts quickly, review your progress with detailed charts, and stay motivated with goals and personal records. CoreWeight also includes a built-in HIIT & Tabata timer, photo comparisons, CSV import, and seamless iCloud sync across your Apple devices.
KEY FEATURES
• Quickly log exercises, sets, reps, and weight with minimal taps
• Create workout menus and routines, or easily repeat previous workouts
• Track training volume, estimated 1RM, body weight, body fat percentage, body measurements, heart rate zones, and more
• Visualize your progress with detailed charts
• Set goals and automatically track personal records
• Compare Before & After photos side by side or with an overlay
• Export progress photos as transition videos
• Built-in HIIT & Tabata interval timer with customizable preparation, work, rest, and round settings
• Sync your data across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch with iCloud
• Import your existing workout history from CSV files
• Create custom tracking fields and units
• Share workouts and personal records with a single tap
• Generate AI-ready prompts based on your recent training data
IPHONE DUO
Works on iPhone Duo. On the wide inner display, see your log, graphs and timer at a larger size.

The Mac version is ad-free.

Your workout history, body measurements, and photos are stored on your device and in your own iCloud account.
No CoreWeight account or login is required.
Google AdMob is used only to display ads in the free iPhone and iPad versions.

apple-macos:1516357927.description:
The Teaching Textbooks Geometry app makes your TT course even better! Not only will your student enjoy math while learning independently, but, with the app, that learning can also take place on the go. Even when offline! Specifically, the app can be used offline for up to 6 lessons at a time. That makes it perfect for homeschool parents who need their kids to stay productive while the family is out and about during the day.
The app’s other features include…
• 110 audiovisual lectures that teach every core concept in the standard 10th grade curriculum
• thousands of problems that give students all the practice they need to master each concept
• automated grading and instant feedback for every single problem
• step-by-step audiovisual explanations to every single problem so students can see exactly what they did wrong when mistakes are made (This makes the program feel as if a tutor is at the student’s side!)
• parental controls that let you track your student’s progress
• the digitized version of the printed Teaching Textbooks Geometry textbook (with a search feature and a hyper-linked index)
• no advertising or in-app purchase offers
• Internet connectivity is required, but you can remain offline for up to 6 lessons.
